'''Trayl Caltos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Following an attack by criminals on a [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]]-producing factory in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Naboo, using illegal heavy weapons, mass hysteria developed among the planet's population. The planetary government hired a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to investigate the source of the illegal weapons and Caltos was appointed to be the mercenarys' contact within the Royal Naboo Security Forces. Caltos offered the mercenaries 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to stake out a warehouse on the outskirts of Theed, which was believed to be the source of the weapons. He also told them that the criminals responsible for the illegal weapons were the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Kal Jorek]] and the [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Frizz (Defel)|Frizz]]. He then gave the mercenaries a short range [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], which they could use to contact him.

While the mercenaries investigated the warehouse, Caltos and some of the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] he commanded came under fire from a group of thugs, who were working for Jorek and Frizz.

{{RPG}}
The mercenaries defeated and captured Jorek and Frizz, and Caltos arrived at the warehouse, to take custody of the criminals. He then paid the mercenaries, for successfully carring out the job.
{{Endgame}}
